meaning: Independent source interpretation of existing authored declarative composition behavior. Expected values and observation order do not come from generated behavior, native outcomes, or production evaluators.
source_binding: The graph-bound entry requires an unchanged registered compiled project snapshot and its exact composition identifier. Capture the authored contract and declared Calculation bindings, preserving authored-to-core argument names and source expression order. Only currently supported typed-calculation/v1 UInt64 contracts are interpreted. Structural record bindings never call factories or enforce invariant references.
private_kernel: A separately exported inert reference kernel supports isolated conformance fixtures. Its contract is a compiler-validated declarative-function/v1 or v2 contract; it does not confer validation or source provenance on an arbitrary contract. The graph-bound entry is required for subsequent public verification. No injected executable Calculation callback is accepted.
capture_and_capacity: Snapshot inert source and caller data independently. Preserve bigint, undefined optional absence, property order and repeated references; reject accessors, symbols, custom prototypes, sparse arrays, cycles, functions and non-finite numbers. Bound depth to 64, copied visits to 20000, own object keys to 2048 and array length to 4096. Source/caller/request capture shares one 8 MiB text/key budget; all detached observations and final values share a second 20000-visit and 8 MiB budget. Evaluation and emitted observations share a 100000 step budget. Capacity failure is a distinct reference-unavailable error, never a domain error or successful partial prefix. Proxy trap isolation is not claimed. Snapshotting is a verifier fixture boundary, not new product input validation or deep-freeze semantics.
expressions: Interpret literal, path, Mapping and Calculation calls, exists, forall and exactly_one. Mapping v1 optional single input and v2 explicit zero-to-128 inputs retain left-to-right once-per-argument-per-call semantics. Zero-input Mapping, Query and Rule values are memoized only after successful computation, per execute invocation. Fields follow authored order. Query evaluates every predicate before any selected projection. exists/forall short-circuit; exactly_one evaluates all rows.
builtins: Preserve strict scalar comparisons, lazy and/or/coalesce, present, not, lower (Unicode normally, ASCII under node-rust-v1), exact uint64/optional_uint64/decimal/format/text, count/one/first/distinct/sort/column. Conversion uses canonical unsigned whole strings without a terminal newline, exact scale 0 through 18 and checked UInt64 bounds. No floating numeric realization or implicit record factory validation.
phases: validateInput executes only original input-only assertions in original order. execute binding input/guard phases retain declared branch selection and missing-binding errors. Ordinary execution evaluates assertions in order, all result conditions in order, requires exactly one match and evaluates only its value. Empty declared binding sets retain the existing ordinary execution behavior.
observations: Compare detached node-start/result/error, query-start/row, assertion, result-case and selected-case observations in exact source evaluation order. Query node-result reports count, not the projected rows. Error normalization retains declared uppercase codes, exact Calculation error tokens or EVALUATION_FAILED. Record full domain failure traces. Reference capacity failures abort rather than masquerading as observed domain failures.
native_evidence: Run actual generated JavaScript modules with independent source-derived expectations. Test exact argument renaming through actual selected native Calculation artifacts and core-api adapter after strict native TypeScript compilation. Compiling behavioral mutants must execute and disagree, not merely fail syntax. Include v1/v2, lazy branches, memoization, collection order, numeric boundaries, binding phases, cardinality, input assertions and observations. No HTTP endpoint, transport integration, database or production provider is executed.
compatibility: Private foundation only. Preserve existing CLI source bytes, 64-source capsule, default/API behavior and public composition not_evaluable status. Add test registration and developer evidence. Source/native binding audits, automatic finite case synthesis, resource admission and public evidence custody are subsequent R08 units.
claim_ceiling: Finite local behavior-reference evidence, not arbitrary-program equivalence, public composition assurance, deployment, admission, release or full CLI completion. The full R08-R18 plan remains active.
